name: test_field_codes
description: Hand-written for the survey import tests: rules for the codes the field-file fixtures under tests/surveyio/data carry (KB, EB, CTRL), one colour of its own and one linestyle.

codes.comment: A kerb: a line, in the customisation's own colour and linestyle
An edge of bitumen: a plain line in a standard colour
A control mark: a point code, never strung
